authority: Vitae curriculum navigation and participant-facing achievement presentation only; no Identity, worth, rank over people, governance, Treasury, entitlement, capability, readiness, or spiritual authority effect
purpose: Ratify the Human Architect's current design decision for the exact fivefold icosahedral 5+10+5 Vitae presentation: a fixed Wizard upper cap, ten-Grade Architect belt, and fixed Magus lower cap, while separating finite curriculum milestones from infinite practice and mastery.

source_posture.mathematical_basis: A regular icosahedron in fivefold orientation decomposes exactly into 5 upper faces + 10 equatorial faces + 5 lower faces.
source_posture.human_architect_decision: 2026-08-24: Architect is the Core-ring achievement; Wizard is the upward/heavens cap; Magus is the downward/transformation cap; Enchanter belongs with Wizard; Druid belongs with Magus.

upper.shared_function: Steward knowing, meaning, perception, scale, symbol, resonance, and orientation without authority.
upper.geometric_marker: north five-face cap; north pole may display the derived Wizard achievement marker

equator.geometric_marker: ten-face equatorial belt; a derived equatorial halo may display the Architect achievement marker
equator.curricular_graph: P10 over a geometric C10; Adept→Guardian closure remains semantically inert unless an explicit revisit mode is selected

lower.shared_function: Steward thresholds, living systems, endings, transformation, construction, maintenance, and form without coercion.
lower.geometric_marker: south five-face cap; south pole may display the derived Magus achievement marker

achievement_contract.historical_receipt_posture: An earned achievement may remain as a record of completed curriculum history; it does not certify permanent character, current behavior, authority, or final mastery.

Architect.candidate_condition: All ten Core Grade completion/recognition requirements are satisfied through Vitae-native evidence and explicit recognition; rendered face fill alone is never sufficient.
Architect.status: structurally defined; exact recognition predicate remains governed by Vitae sources
Architect.effect: unlocks eligibility to enter specialization curriculum because current specialization canon places specialization entry after Core Vitae; does not grant governance authority

Wizard.candidate_condition: Architect achievement present plus a future-defined foundational curriculum cycle completed for each of the five Wizard-cap specializations.
Wizard.status: title and membership decision ratified as design candidate; finite foundational completion predicate not yet defined in repository
Wizard.mastery_boundary: Completing the foundational cap cycle does not complete or master Arcanist, Philosopher, Illusionist, Astrologer, or Enchanter practice.

Magus.candidate_condition: Architect achievement present plus a future-defined foundational curriculum cycle completed for each of the five Magus-cap specializations.
Magus.status: title and membership decision ratified as design candidate; finite foundational completion predicate not yet defined in repository
Magus.mastery_boundary: Completing the foundational cap cycle does not complete or master Hierophant, Druid, Necromancer, Alchemist, or Artificer practice.

coexistence.reason: No additional prestige ladder or completion apex is introduced by this decision.

directional_semantics.heavens_claim: symbolic/navigation metaphor, not a scientific or moral hierarchy
directional_semantics.descent_claim: symbolic/navigation metaphor for embodiment, passage, transformation, and form, not degradation or lesser worth

name_collision_firewalls: Vitae achievement title Architect ≠ Human Architect constitutional role.
Vitae achievement title Architect ≠ Architect subsystem/application/system role.
Wizard and Magus achievement titles ≠ governance offices or permission envelopes.
Achievement title ≠ specialization identity; roles remain inhabited practices, not fixed identities.
geometry_boundaries: The five edges inside each cap do not create specialization prerequisites or preferred pairings.
The five cap-to-belt edges do not create Grade↔specialization correspondences.
The north and south achievement markers are derived UI markers, not new curriculum nodes.
The remaining icosahedral vertices receive no semantics from this registry.
Face illumination records participant-visible curriculum history only and may not become a worth/readiness percentage.

canon_conflict.mastery_path_governance_canon: Currently rejects formal Wizard/Magus master titles and formalized hybrid tracks.
canon_conflict.cross_specialization_mastery_paths_canon: Currently enumerates Wizard, Magus, and Architect mastery archetypes but states they are not titles with power and not completion states.
canon_conflict.decision: Do not rewrite either canon in this gate. This registry intentionally proposes a new Architecture-v2 distinction: achievement title != mastery path != governance role. Canon reconciliation is required before promotion.

required_features: fixed Wizard upper cap and Magus lower cap
Core-first gate before specialization achievement simulation

candidate_laws: Achievement Is a Milestone, Not Mastery.
The Ring May Be Completed; Becoming Remains Open.
Architect the Achievement Is Not Architect the Office.
Upward and Downward Are Directions, Not Ranks.
Wizard and Magus May Coexist Without Forming a Ladder.
A Title May Remember Accomplishment Without Defining Identity.
Cap Completion Does Not Close Specialization Practice.
Geometry May Stage an Achievement; Evidence Must Earn It.
next_gate: Define the finite foundational specialization-cycle contract that can legitimately trigger Wizard/Magus achievement without contradicting specialization infinite-depth doctrine; then test the single-portal Hope→Vitae→ARCnet→Tempus zoom using this fixed achievement axis.
